name: core30-starter
//: deploy:* read the Cloudflare Pages project from $CF_PAGES_PROJECT (see .env.example). It is client config; npm scripts cannot read site.config.json, so it travels as an env var rather than being hardcoded per client.

scripts.deploy:staging: astro build && node scripts/stamp-staging-noindex.mjs && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=$CF_PAGES_PROJECT --branch=staging --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:prod: astro build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=$CF_PAGES_PROJECT --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
